transcription.not_checked: men and women: this transcription holds totals only. The page itself was not re-read; the copy read was not kept and has no recorded digest.

units: counts.csv: the country and its 28 census districts, totals only. units.csv names each district's unit in geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian BWA ADM2; eight names differ and were matched by hand. Their shapeIDs are not recorded: that level is not in the boundaries repository.

reviewed.found: Added from Fieldwork's population example. The source paper was retitled or replaced on the office's site; re-reading Table 1 from it is open.

offered.why: Fieldwork offers the table in the units today's maps use, with geoBoundaries' name for each, so a census relates to a map of the districts without anyone retyping a name. The printed counts (counts.csv) stay here as the source, and every check runs on them.

districts.label: Its 28 census districts, with geoBoundaries' names
districts.what: The census districts with the name geoBoundaries gives each, written by scripts/districts_today.py. Counts as printed.
districts.how: Paired with the 28 units of geoBoundaries' BWA ADM2 file as the population example's district table pairs them (example-population-models-census, data/botswana_census_2022_districts.csv): 20 by the same name; 8 where geoBoundaries spells the district another way: Sowa as Sowa Town, Delta as Ngamiland Delta, CKGR as Central Kgalagadi Game Reserve, and Central Serowe/Palapye, Mahalapye, Bobonong, Boteti and Tutume without 'Central'.
does_not_establish: That each census district's limits are geoBoundaries' unit's: the pairing is by name, not by shape.
geoBoundaries' shapeIDs for Botswana: the file the example read carried none, so none is given.
